section_summary.extract_value: The section reports an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) of the 13-item Portuguese Body Appreciation Scale (KMO = .90; Bartlett's test significant), extracting two factors with eigenvalues 5.35 and 1.74 (explaining 41.1% and 13.4% of variance). The first factor (General body appreciation; 10 items) had Cronbach's α = .89 and was retained for further analyses, while the second (Body image investment) had α = .67 and was not retained. An independent-samples t-test showed men scored higher than women on General body appreciation (women M = 3.90, SD = 0.67; men M = 4.11, SD = 0.57), t(309) = 2.83, p = .005, d = 0.32. No study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') or multiple separate studies are mentioned in this section.
